changes: Legacy MOVEJ target is measured q plus bounded arm velocity intent times dt, bounded by .03 rad lead and joint limits.
Every base/time sample checks measured q, target midpoint and exact delivered target; original measured-dq velocity/braking envelope is retained.
Existing outer lead check, execution gates, driver, SDK, thresholds and position-servo branch unchanged.
limits: Three pose slices and 50 ms time samples remain a discrete geometric check, not a full continuous sweep certificate.
fixed_vel=1 actual response is uncalibrated; this does not enable the simulation position-servo model on hardware.
High measured dq may still correctly cause collision, joint-limit or forecast-bound rejection.
No live control or real-world performance validation in this change.
